markers.title: Lactase persistence
markers.studyNote: This variant is associated with continued lactase production, especially in European populations. Other variants can produce the same trait, so its absence does not establish lactose intolerance.

markers.title: Alcohol flush
read: this ALDH2-related flush variant is absent
reduced ALDH2 activity; alcohol flushing is more likely
very low ALDH2 activity; strong alcohol flushing is more likely
markers.studyNote: The linked review describes increased oesophageal cancer risk among people with one copy of this variant who drink alcohol.

markers.title: Earwax & body odor
read: wet earwax associated with this genotype
dry earwax and reduced underarm odour associated with this genotype

cite.label: Martin et al., Journal of Investigative Dermatology 2010

markers.studyNote: The earwax study links two copies of this allele to dry earwax. The second study links the same genotype to reduced secretion of key underarm odour precursors.

markers.title: Eye color (major locus)
read: brown eyes more likely in the study
brown or intermediate eye colour more likely in the study
blue eyes more likely in the study

cite.label: Sturm et al., American Journal of Human Genetics 2008

markers.studyNote: The study mainly involved people of northern European ancestry. Other variants also influence eye colour; this is an association, not a definite prediction.

markers.title: Warfarin dose sensitivity
read: lower warfarin sensitivity than T carriers in the study
increased warfarin sensitivity in the study
highest warfarin sensitivity in the study
markers.studyNote: Warfarin dose requirements also depended on other genes, age and body size in this study. This variant alone does not determine a dose.
